integrity: Two standalone Python 3 checkers with recorded results: direct graph enumeration for 53 graphs and 1,024,064 configurations, and independent exact weighted block enumeration for 1,681 parameter pairs. All-size proof is symbolic via explicit transition cases, not finite extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: Valid for a,b >= 3; labelled synchronous binary open-neighborhood majority with inertia on ties, and one added intrashore edge. Counts recurrent states and primitive two-cycles, not basins, transients, multiple inserted edges, or spatial-isomorphism classes. Historical priority not conclusively established; complete original Goles-Olivos paper unavailable.
title: An intrashore bond converts balanced majority equilibria into oscillations
